title: LiouScope: Multi-Diagnostic Relaxation Analysis for Open Quantum Lattice Systems
description: Multi-diagnostic relaxation analysis framework for finite-dimensional time-homogeneous Markovian open quantum lattice systems (GKSL / QMS). Implements twenty diagnostics D1-D20 organised in six layers S/N/R/U/C/G and a twelve-class mechanism taxonomy A1-A12.
